verdict.rationale: A first-party AI surface for asking questions of files, summarizing or extracting is a fair question for a cloud storage product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only Graph file APIs, keyword search, thumbnails, versioning and sharing. Nothing in it documents a shipped AI feature that answers questions about, summarizes or extracts from stored content.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, the storage understands its contents — a first-party AI surface (ask questions of files, summarize, extract) shipped and documented, not just announced
